parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC address of the affiliated STA whose link stats are being reported.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the affiliated STA.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of bytes received from the affiliated STA.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the affiliated STA.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of packets received from the affiliated STA.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the affiliated STA because of errors.

object.description: This object describes the final per link stats of each affiliated STA on disassociation. Applies only to Multi-Link Device (MLD) links. EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Affiliated STA Traffic Stats.
